Aspose.Email FOSS for Python

Package:
- aspose-email-foss

Public import root:
- aspose.email_foss

Main modules:
- aspose.email_foss.msg
- aspose.email_foss.cfb

High-level API:
- aspose.email_foss.msg.MapiMessage

Low-level MSG API:
- aspose.email_foss.msg.MsgReader
- aspose.email_foss.msg.MsgWriter
- aspose.email_foss.msg.MsgDocument

Low-level CFB API:
- aspose.email_foss.cfb.CFBReader
- aspose.email_foss.cfb.CFBWriter
- aspose.email_foss.cfb.CFBDocument

Docs:
